signals.title: Andretta-Bisaccia site-management recruitment signal
signals.note: Progeco Group is recruiting a Deputy/Site Manager for specialist support on the Andretta-Bisaccia wind repowering. The posting describes 18 WTG / 88.5 MW, a new SSE and MT/AT interconnection cables, with supervision of foundations, roads and civil works.

signals.title: 24-month site-support requirement
signals.note: The current recruitment signal indicates a multi-year site-support window around the project. It strengthens mobilisation timing but does not identify the executing civil, electrical, foundation or logistics contractors.
